title: SVB powerbox boot drain has no overall deadline
summary: - Location: indigo_drivers/aux_svbpowerbox/indigo_aux_svbpowerbox.driver:141-157, especially 147-156. - Severity: medium; confidence: high; category: functional/availability. Owner: coordinator; status: open; nonblocking audit follow-up. - Evidence: comment promises "up to 3 seconds, 300 ms silence", but the loop is conditioned only on repeated 300000-microsecond waits. No overall deadline, byte cap or iteration limit exists. Successful arriving data resets the effective wait indefinitely. - Impact: a controller in a reset/logging loop or continuous serial noise can keep the serialized connect handler active indefinitely, postponing disconnect and other operations. No hardware interaction or induced failure occurred. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (AC-3). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
